laws.rule: Touat-Gourara Tidikelt Cultural Park, named Timimoun airport, Aougrout and the Gourara checkpoints access points: Executive Decree 14-05 directs entry through surveillance/control posts. Tourist visits in designated protection zones must be organised through public bodies or licensed tourism agencies and accompanied by a park-appointed guide, approximately one guide per ten visitors. Agency activities in those zones need prior park-office authorisation. This is not a guide requirement throughout the whole wilaya or permission to cross an international border.

Touat-Gourara Tidikelt Cultural Park protection zones: the decree prohibits collection of cultural/natural objects, unauthorised mineral or fossil removal, and damage to wild plants. Do not wet, take moulds of, scratch, write on or detach rock-art surfaces. Organised professional film/photo activity requires prior culture-ministry permission and an agreement with the park office; normal tourist admission does not provide this authorisation.

sources.title: JORADP: Executive Decree 14-05, Touat-Gourara Tidikelt Cultural Park
sources.supports: Read directly: park boundaries and named control posts, organised protected-zone visits with appointed guide and prior agency authorisation, professional photography and rock-art/collection restrictions. Articles 30, 35 to 39.

local-law.note: Named cultural-park zones only. Original 2012/2014 instrument, not a verified current consolidation. Gate locations are mapped to present wilayas, not the older province labels. Current access, live zoning and later amendments not yet checked. No fee amounts reproduced.

festivals: Gourara Sbuâ: CNRPAH describes an annual week of pilgrimage associated with the celebration of the Prophet Muhammad's birth, culminating on the seventh day at Sidi El-Hadj Belkacem. No Gregorian date is calculated and this is not declared a wilaya public holiday.

sources.title: CNRPAH: Sbuâ in Gourara
sources.authority: Centre national de recherches préhistoriques, anthropologiques et historiques, Algeria
sources.supports: Read directly: published 2024 description: annual Mawlid-related week, culminating on day seven at Sidi El-Hadj Belkacem.
